atoms.a: The private tutoring at boarding school helps boarders to keep up with the schoolwork.
There are many different extracurricular activities in boarding school.
Boarders ask their houseparents for advice, because their parents are far away.

instruction.text: Entscheide, ob die Aussagen wahr oder falsch sind.

atoms.a: Boarders see their families every day.
Boarders see their families on the holidays.
Boarders join clubs, but don't have free time.
Boarders have free time every day after their extracurricular activities.

instruction.text: Lies dir den Text durch und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: Jisoo says: “I had mixed feelings about boarding schools before I became a boarder. And now, after being in boarding school and living in a dorm for years, I can say that it was a good choice. It wasn't always easy. I've missed my parents and siblings often. Especially on birthdays I wanted to be at home and celebrate with my family. But you get used to it with time. And you build a second home in boarding school. For me, the best part of boarding school was that I became more independent. I can imagine going to university in another city or move to a different country alone.”

atoms.a: Does she regret her choice of becoming a boarder?
